responsibility: Provides the generated documentation-to-option mapping for the MicroBlaze target option table. This companion file to microblaze.opt lists each MicroBlaze-specific command-line switch and the corresponding HTML manual anchor suffix in the GCC manual, so generated option metadata and diagnostics/help systems can link target options such as CPU selection, endian mode, floating-point mode, and hardware-feature flags to the correct 'MicroBlaze Options' documentation entry; it does not define option semantics or parsing itself.
